summary: Kit plays now run for changes to the app changelog files the kit's Changelog stories render, and the kit lane fails when the Storybook module graph bundles a repository file outside the declared kit inputs.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No application or API change. CI only: kit plays run for more changes (apps/fractal-web/src/changelog/**), never fewer; the kit Storybook build also writes its module graph for the coverage check.
